kind.question: What sort of thing is it? Exactly one.

values.science: Empirical knowledge or an explanation of the world.
values.mathematics: A formal result, a representation or a method of calculation.
values.technology: An artifact, instrument, material or reproducible technical process.
values.practice: A learned skill or a social, organisational or cultural system, held in people more than in objects.

origin.question: How did this community come to have it? Exactly one.

values.first_known: The earliest known achievement of this thing anywhere.
values.independent: Reached separately, with no evidenced knowledge of an earlier achievement elsewhere.
values.derived: Reached through evidenced transmission from an earlier achievement, then adopted or adapted.
values.revival: Deliberately recovered or rebuilt after having been lost or abandoned.
values.unknown: Investigated, and the evidence does not settle whether it was independent.

advance.question: What was actually new? An entry can have several values.

values.observation: A phenomenon or object seen or detected for the first time.
values.measurement: A quantity established, or established more precisely.
values.experimental_method: A new way of finding things out.
values.explanation: A new account of why something happens.
values.unification: Separate bodies of knowledge shown to be one.
values.mathematical_method: A new way of calculating, proving or representing.
values.correction: An accepted idea shown to be wrong or replaced.
values.dataset: A compiled resource others can draw on.
values.standard_or_scale: A unit, scale, classification or interface others adopt.
values.field_or_clinical_trial: A deliberate test in real conditions, on patients or at sea for example.
values.operating_principle: A device that works in a fundamentally new way.
values.device_or_configuration: A new artefact or arrangement using known principles.
values.performance_improvement: The same thing made measurably better.
values.material: A new or newly controllable substance.
values.manufacturing_process: A new way of making something.
values.cost_or_scale: The same thing made cheap or plentiful enough to change who uses it.
values.system_integration: Existing parts combined into a working whole.
values.infrastructure: A shared facility or network that others build on.
values.craft_practice: Skill held in people and practice more than in documents.
values.new_application: An existing thing put to a different use.
values.codification_or_teaching: Knowledge written down or taught so it can spread.
values.reconstruction: Something earlier rebuilt or revived deliberately.

scale.question: How far did it disturb what came before? Choose one.

values.incremental: Technology: better within the same design.
values.modular: Technology: one component changes, and the overall design stays.
values.architectural: Technology: known components rearranged in a new way.
values.radical: Technology: new principle and new arrangement.
values.revises: Science: changes part of accepted understanding.
values.opens_field: Science: makes a new line of enquiry possible.

prompted_by.question: What set people working on this? This is the prompt, not the enabler. An entry can have several values.

values.new_capability: A new instrument, method or material made people go and look.
values.prior_theory: A theory made a prediction or pointed somewhere.
values.data_or_measurements: Existing results demanded better accuracy or explanation.
values.anomaly_or_failure: Something did not fit, or something broke.
values.practical_need: An engineering, medical, navigational or everyday problem.
values.state_or_military: A government, war or defence requirement.
values.transfer_from_other_field: An idea carried across from another discipline.
values.transmission_from_other_place: News or an example arriving from elsewhere.
values.systematic_search: A deliberate, broad programme of trying things.
values.accident: An unplanned result that someone recognised.
values.curiosity: Understanding for its own sake, with no stated use.

limit_removed.question: Which bottleneck did it relieve? Several values allowed.

values.scale: Doing more of it, or a larger one.
values.access: Letting more people or places do it.
values.conceptual: A way of thinking was the obstacle.

reception.question: How was it received? Exactly one.

values.immediate: Taken up quickly by its community.
values.gradual: Spread slowly without a real dispute.
values.delayed: Largely ignored, then taken up much later.
values.lost_and_recovered: Knowledge or practice lost, then recovered.

end_reason.question: If it ended or declined, why? Several values allowed.

values.better_substitute: Something else did the job better.
values.input_or_skill_lost: A material, supplier or skill disappeared.
values.regulation_or_safety: It was restricted or judged unsafe.
values.maker_failure: The company or institution behind it ended.

fate.question: Where does it stand today? Exactly one.

values.niche: Survives in limited, specialist, ceremonial or heritage use.
values.incorporated: No longer distinct, because later work absorbed it.
values.superseded: Replaced by something better and no longer used.
values.abandoned: Given up without a direct replacement.
values.lost: The knowledge or skill itself was lost.

setting.question: In what kind of setting was the work done? Several values allowed.

values.community: A village, band or people acting together.
values.workshop: A craft workshop or small maker.
values.religious: A temple, monastery, mission or other religious body.
values.state: A government office, works or laboratory.
values.military: An army, navy or defence body.
values.expedition: A voyage, survey or field expedition.

funding.question: Who paid for the work? Several values allowed.

known_from.question: What kind of record tells us about it? Several values allowed.

values.contemporary_text: Writing from the time, by those involved or near them.
values.inscription: A text cut or painted on a durable object.
values.patent: A patent or other legal claim.
values.scientific_publication: A paper, report or treatise presenting the work.
values.image: A drawing, painting, photograph or film.
values.oral_tradition: Knowledge handed down by word of mouth.
values.ethnographic_account: An outside observer's record of living practice.

event.question: What happened? Each dated event has exactly one type.

values.invention: A working thing was first made.
values.observation: A phenomenon was seen or detected.
values.formulation: An explanation, law or method was worked out.
values.presentation: It was presented to an audience.
values.documented_description: A dated text or image describes it.
values.public_disclosure: It was made public by other means.
values.patent: A patent was filed or granted.
values.practical_use: It was used for real work.
values.practical_deployment: It was installed or put into service.
values.first_commercial_availability: It could be bought for the first time anywhere.
values.public_availability: It was open to the public without sale.
values.adoption: A community or place took it up.
values.transmission: It reached a new place or community from elsewhere.
values.acceptance: Its community came to accept it.
values.dated_assertion: A dated record whose stage has not been classified.

date_status.question: How well is the date known?

values.approximate: The evidence gives roughly this date.
values.bounded: The evidence gives a limit or a range, not the date itself.

values.origin: Where it was devised, made or first done.
values.findspot: Where evidence of it was found.
values.publication: Where it was published or presented.
values.study: Where it was later studied or reconstructed.

values.originator: Devised, discovered or first made it.
values.builder: Made the object or carried out the work.
values.author: Wrote the account that records it.
values.observer: Witnessed or recorded it without taking part.

place_kind.question: What sort of place is it?

values.site: A building, works, excavation or other single location.
values.area: A district, province, island or other part of a country.
values.region: A named area larger than or cutting across countries.
values.water: A sea, ocean, lake or river.

world_region.question: Which part of the world? These match the population series.

values.north_america: North and Central America and the Caribbean.
values.oceania: Australia, New Zealand and the Pacific islands.

organization_kind.question: What sort of organisation is it?

values.workshop: A craft workshop or small maker.

society_kind.question: What sort of society is it?

values.polity: A state, empire, kingdom or other government.
values.people: A people or nation identified by name.

link.question: How are the two discoveries connected? The link is stored on the later or receiving discovery and points at the other.

values.builds_on: It developed out of the other.
values.requires: It could not work without the function the other provides.
values.uses_instrument: The other is the instrument that made this observation possible.
values.uses_process: The other is the process that made this production possible.
values.uses_theory: The other is the theory that informed this design.
values.transmitted_from: Knowledge of the other actually travelled and was received.
values.part_of: It is one component or refinement of the other.
values.independent_of: The same thing reached separately, with no evidenced contact.
values.companion_of: The two worked together as parts of one arrangement.
values.same_principle: The two rest on the same documented principle.
values.same_family: The two belong to one documented family of designs.

link_status.question: How far has the link been established?

values.candidate: A question worth researching. It is not a claim.
values.insufficient: Researched, and the evidence found does not support it.

contribution.question: What passed from the other discovery to this one? Several values allowed.

values.supplied_instrument: It was the tool used to observe or measure.
values.supplied_component: It became a part of the later thing.
values.supplied_platform: It was the base on which the later work took place.
values.supplied_theory_or_design_rule: It told people what to do or expect.
values.supplied_data: Its numbers or results were used.
values.posed_problem: It raised the question being answered.
values.challenged_or_refuted: The later work argued against it.
values.improved_on: The later thing is a better version in the same line.
values.replaced: The later thing displaced it in practice.
values.implemented: An idea or design was turned into a working thing.
values.applied_to_new_use: It was carried into a different purpose.
values.taught_or_transmitted: Knowledge of it was passed on.
values.stimulated: News or example prompted the work without supplying its content.

carrier.question: How did it get across? Several values allowed.

values.migration: A person with the knowledge moved.
values.artifact_or_copying: Someone had the object and copied or studied it.

influence.question: How much did this discovery rely on the other?

values.essential: Essential to this specific historical instance, not every possible route.

confidence.question: How well does the evidence support the statement?

values.high: Directly stated by a good source.

basis.question: Where does a recorded value come from?

values.sourced: From evidence cited on the record.
values.recalled: From general knowledge, entered without checking a source. Treat as a lead to verify.
values.reviewed: Checked against the evidence by a second reader.
values.unknown: Investigated, and the evidence does not settle it.
values.not_applicable: The question does not apply to this discovery.

research_status.question: How far has the whole record been taken?

values.draft: Written up, with some claims not yet sourced.
values.sourced: Its dated events and links cite evidence.

access.question: How much of the source was read?

lead_status.question: Where does a research lead stand?

grain.question: How large a thing does this record stand for? Exactly one.

values.capability: A community gained the ability to do or understand something new.
values.improvement: A notable step within a capability that already existed.
values.instance: One object, site, trial or text that shows a capability at work.
